in_sanskrit.name: Khushi
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feeling of being well and content; a state of happiness and satisfaction.

in_marathi.name: Khushika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khushika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Khushika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Khush' meaning joy and happiness. It is a name bestowed upon a child born into a prosperous and contented family or one who brings happiness to others.
